headline: 0.24.1 is published. 0.24.0 made graphite (#433A3F, inverting per theme) the one brand accent, made the font dial reach every type role, added a reserved mauve scale and docs/ENGINEERING.md; 0.24.1 re-values 16 component tokens to what the components render (#595). The Figma library matches the tokens again (drift 0, apple retired), CI scans the full history for secrets (#263), and the README marks the agent-consistency eval as an open exploration.
next: hds#592: llms.txt as a conformant index (absolute links, no timestamp) with a check-llms-txt gate; the body moves to llms-full.txt.
hds#593: eval after-arm scoring, in its own thread: find where agents diverge and fix the docs that cause it.
Figma: publish the library (Adrian) so files using it pick up graphite; agents never publish.
blocked: Adrian: Code Connect needs a Figma ORGANIZATION plan. On Pro the v2 templates generate and gate locally but cannot publish, so Dev Mode shows no HDS snippets and designers get no code-to-design jump. A plan purchase, not a code problem

Adrian: #126 — CHROMATIC_PROJECT_TOKEN in Actions secrets + CHROMATIC_ENABLED=true in Actions variables. Verified this session that the chromatic job green-SKIPS without it (if: vars.CHROMATIC_ENABLED == 'true'), so a passing chromatic check on any recent PR means NOTHING ran. autoAcceptChanges is already wired for main, so no manual baseline accept is needed once enabled

Adrian: two community UI kits (Material 3 Design Kit, Simple Design System) are subscribed to the HDS Figma file, so every design-system search returns their components alongside ours. Figma -> Assets panel -> book icon -> toggle both off
resolvedThisSession: 0.24.0 published: graphite accent, working font dial (#478), mauve reserved scale, ENGINEERING.md (#589), docs truth pass (#545, #403).
#263: CI runs a pinned, checksum-verified gitleaks over the full history (PR #602).
Figma library synced to the tokens: graphite + mauve created, textDisabled moved to Component, apple and the old textDisabled deleted with Adrian's OK (PR #607).
